longmemeval.reason: Preparation timers combine indexing and retrieval, share cached embeddings across lanes, and do not isolate ingestion. Full standard context does not fit on any of 300 items. No full-standard answer latency/output tokens exist. Oracle context is not a full-history substitute.

intervals: No population CI: only two independent LoCoMo histories. Per-history sensitivity is reported, not question-level pseudoreplication.

four_system_locomo.rule: All saved-answer IDs shared by four systems, restricted to histories with complete recorded ingestion intervals; no accuracy or judge-completion filtering
four_system_locomo.attribution: Actual user payload excluding system examples and EXAMPLE blocks; CURRENT_MESSAGE and speaker labels take precedence; speaker aliases mapped from source histories, then intersected with recorded ingestion intervals

admission.rag_ingestion: No LLM ingestion in the upstream harness; embedding tokens and indexing seconds unrecorded

bootstrap.unit: whole history, with replacement; all paired systems and observed question counts retained
bootstrap.limitation: Only four independent histories when N_histories=4; percentile intervals are descriptive and unstable, not evidence of broad population precision.
bootstrap.null_endpoint: No finite crossover; infinite draws retained
